author: sam1270
body:
Hi. I am sam1270.

My ING ingame is sam1270.
I have been banned accidentally for Pornlinks.

I don't know why I have been banned for this because I did not post this.


If I did something wrong, I am sorry but this is not the category of my ban. 
This afternoon, I logged on and I saw a ban screen. I did not even connect myself for hours. This morning, I played 2 games in Nebula and everything was cool. Then, this happens.

I thank you for reviewing this ban appeal and I hope you'll understand.
-sam1270
